decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The proposed single storey side and rear extension, by way of its position, design and appearance, has due regard for the sites' characteristics and that of the subject dwellinghouse and would not be detrimental to the general amenity of the adjoining properties or the traffic related amenity of the surrounding area and is in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing standards and Guidelines), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 5 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western sidewall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey side extension to dwellinghouse.
